Name: Let Krobus Say the F Word
Author: Durinthal
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Visit the sewer after you have 3 hearts with Krobus and it's not Friday.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It might conflict with other mods that add/change dialogue for Krobus. If it breaks, it breaks.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the modding community on the Stardew Valley Discord server for enlightening me and making me realize I could create this silly little mod in a couple of hours.[/color]

[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]Happy April Fools' Day![/color][/spoiler]
